spec-4-1-warning-forecast.md (Boundaries, Golden): "Re-bless = ALL `.t1`/`.log.bin` (catalog_hash fold — mechanical, cause-documented) + T2s that shift (a demo that strains at a capture gains rings/halos: sla + qos_contention (the saturated router row), qos_emphasis (era-3 load), qos.dem's 65 s capture (the panel + surge strain), lose.dem (its own stuck packet ...); boot/draw/flow/win/bundle/ecmp/place/demolish T2s stay pixel-identical — the negative proof). **STOP + flag any shift beyond the documented set**"

Re-sim at the reviewed sha (probe linked to the worktree core, seed 3003 / era 3 / fixture qos / draws at tick 3; per-tick hashes byte-match the blessed goldens/qos.t1, e.g. tick 3 5d3f0031a24dfd1e, tick 20 777ec8a260a2fea7): "tick 20: node_strain=[0:None 1:None 2:None 3:None 4:None ] pipe_strain=[0:Red 1:Red 2:Red 3:Red ] forecast=[]" — the 1000 ms capture (tick 20) carries Red pressure on ALL four pipes, so the frame's new pixels are the pressure halos (pixel diff vs base: bbox (356,355,914,526), 8996 px, dominant new color (232,69,69) = state_critical). The 65 s capture (tick 1300, forecast=[sp0@1200A]) matches the documented cause (panel + halos: 13500 px in the top-right panel region incl. card (253,249,240) + NOW-row red, 7088 px center halos).
detail: The golden-shift story enumerates ONLY qos.dem's '65 s capture' as the qos T2 shift; the 1 s capture shifted with real content and no documented cause — a shift beyond the documented set per the spec's own STOP+flag gate. The 'pre-saturation / no-strain' framing in the review brief is empirically false at this sha: era-3 demand saturates the fixture from ~tick 6 (drops from tick 4, all pipes at the E9 bound at the 1 s capture, pre-surge). The re-bless itself is honest and reproducible (drop stream + non-warning event stream byte-identical to the base sim — verified by diffing base vs new probes, 8639/8639 drops equal); the cause-documentation is incomplete.
recommended_fix: Extend the implementation spec's golden-shift story (Boundaries + Design Notes) to enumerate qos.dem's 1000 ms capture: era-3 baseline demand saturates all four pipes (Red pressure) by the first capture, long before the 60 s surge; the 1 s frame legitimately gains the pressure halos.
